story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price BAJAJ-AUTO to move about ±5.9%, roughly 9,892 to 11,124. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 59% of the time.

For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 11,000 (+4.9% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 10,000 (-4.6%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.

Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap +0.3 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for BAJAJ-AUTO: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.
Options on BAJAJ-AUTO are priced for moves of about 1.57% a day. That is normal for BAJAJ-AUTO compared with the past year.
